stemMd: Five measurements have mean 18. Four of them are 12, 16, 20 and 21. What is the fifth?
explanationMd: The total must be 5 times 18=90. The four known measurements sum to 69, so the fifth is 90−69=21.

distractorRationale.d: This is the required total of all five.
distractorRationale.a: This is the mean of the four known values.
distractorRationale.b: A single missing observation need not equal the mean.
